{{Top|leg}}
'''Sensor masts''' were sensory devices used aboard [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyers]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebels]] at the [[Defiant Core]] Rebel base salvaged the three fourty-[[Meter/Legends|meter]]-tall sensor masts that were formerly a part of the ''[[Nova Defiant/Legends|Nova Defiant]]'' to use in their base.<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
